We need to call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with molecule_smiles = "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1". Criteria: functional_groups_broken maybe "sulfonamides"? Actually forward reaction forms sulfonamide, so broken groups are amine and acyl chloride? In forward, amine and sulfonyl chloride react, so broken groups: amine (N-H) and acyl chloride (S-Cl). But functional groups broken list includes "primary amines", "secondary amines", "acyl chloride". So we can set functional_groups_broken = ["primary amines", "acyl chloride"]? However the target contains a sulfonamide, not amine. The template will break sulfonamide into amine and sulfonyl chloride. So in forward direction, functional groups formed: sulfonamides. Broken: primary amines, acyl chloride. So search with functional_groups_formed=["sulfonamides"], functional_groups_broken=["primary amines","acyl chloride"].

Let's try.
